name: Clock
description: Analog or digital clock with optional date.

style.label: Style
style.help: Digital text clock or analog clock face.

show_seconds.label: Show seconds
show_seconds.help: Display a seconds indicator (updates every second).

show_date.label: Show date
show_date.help: Display the current date below the time.

custom_format.label: Custom time format
custom_format.help: Optional strftime pattern (digital only) that overrides the 12h/24h + seconds toggles when non-empty, e.g. '%-I:%M %p' or '%a %H:%M'. Leave empty for the friendly toggles.

extra_source.label: Extra text source
extra_source.help: off = none; text = show the static 'Extra text' string; file = show the live contents of /dev/shm/clock.txt (polled by the worker).

extra_text.label: Extra text
extra_text.help: Static line shown below the time when 'Extra text source' is 'text'.
